description.APPROVE: The media will be approved and the posts waiting for it will be published.
description.REJECT: The media will be rejected and the posts that contain it will be hidden. This decision is final.
description.KEEP: The reports will be closed and the content will stay visible.
description.REMOVE: The reports will be closed and the content will be removed.
description.SUSPEND: The author will not be able to use their account. This action is destructive and requires a reason.

errors.generic: We could not complete the action. Please try again.
errors.ALREADY_MODERATED: Another moderator already resolved this content. We refreshed the queue.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check your network and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: A service did not respond in time.
errors.INVALID_RESPONSE: The server replied with an unexpected format.
errors.REPORT_NOT_FOUND: The reports for this content were not found.
